trailhead.label: The car park at Campo Moro, the board’s start

cautions: Rocky stretches between boulders and slabs, rougher towards the pass: take it slowly with your dog.
Cattle graze the Alpe Campagneda in summer: keep your distance and your dog close.
Open ground above 2,000 m with no shade; storms build fast on summer afternoons.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
